statement: Provide a dockable, resizable command window that accepts commands and system variables with auto-complete, a suggestion list with synonym and misspelling support, command history cycling, an F2 text window, and a configurable number of temporary prompt history lines.

source.ref: About Entering Commands in the Command Window

superiority: Fuzzy command search with preview and localized aliases.

acceptance.sketch: Typing "CIR" suggests CIRCLE; Down arrow cycles; F2 shows 400 lines of history; option letters in capitals accepted.

notes: Verified against help page "About Entering Commands in the Command Window". Corrected: CLIPROMPTLINES sets temporary prompt-history lines (0-50), not a command line buffer; synonym and AutoCorrect lists are configured per the suggestion list page. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-06F6A6E9-C355-43F5-8706-49F0E5E552BF ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-74478DCE-92D4-49B1-93E9-DCF09D57FA0D ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-8B14D930-2B19-497D-B61E-EFD95296221C | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Load command aliases from a PGP file using lines of the form abbreviation,*COMMAND (including hyphen-prefixed forms), reload them on demand, and ship defaults such as L, C, CO, M, E, TR and EX; aliases are not usable in scripts.
superiority: Aliases are per-user JSON with conflict detection and shareable.

acceptance.sketch: Alias L maps to LINE; user alias DD -> DIMLINEAR added in PGP; REINIT applies.

notes: Verified against help page "About Creating Command Aliases". Corrected: Alias lines are 'abbr, *command' with no flags field (flags apply to external commands). Reload is REINIT / RE-INIT, Windows only. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-BD3AD667-EBFC-4C0A-A691-C07D4436DAB0 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F68C58E5-9C43-447B-85F0-3918CC346DA0 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Alias; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Let non-selecting, non-creating commands run transparently at any prompt when typed with a leading apostrophe, show >> prompts for them, then resume the interrupted command.

source.ref: Interrupt a Command with Another Command

acceptance.sketch: 'ZOOM during LINE retains the line state; 'CAL gives a point result used by LINE.

notes: Verified against help page "About Entering Commands in the Command Window". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Display command options with capitalized shortcut letters and the default value in angle brackets, accept the default on Enter, accept options by clicking or typing the capital letter, and offer options in the command shortcut menu when present.

acceptance.sketch: ARC prompt lists Center/End; typing C accepts; Enter repeats last command.

notes: Verified against help page "To Work With Entering Commands". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-BB0C3E79-66AF-4557-9140-D31B4CF3C9CF ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-7C6AE349-DDF0-40DF-9D1E-FA9702BE88BB | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Treat Space and Enter as equivalent for completing input, repeat the last command on Enter or Space at an empty prompt, and let right-click act as Enter or open a shortcut menu according to the Right-Click Customization settings and SHORTCUTMENU.

acceptance.sketch: Enter at empty prompt repeats; multiple commands via Space except in text.

notes: Verified against help page "To Work With Entering Commands". Corrected: There is no RIGHTCLICK setting; behavior is configured in the Right-Click Customization dialog and the SHORTCUTMENU system variable. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-7C6AE349-DDF0-40DF-9D1E-FA9702BE88BB ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-27079CDD-85E0-4883-A961-82C8FC5C7F46 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Repeat a typed command until Esc with MULTIPLE (parameters are re-prompted each time and dialog commands are not repeated), and re-run recent commands from the Recent Input list or with the Up arrow.

acceptance.sketch: MULTIPLE CIRCLE repeats prompt; Esc ends.

notes: Verified against help page "MULTIPLE (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-945C8F74-064C-4EA6-99E1-232E6003CE27 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Provide hyphen-prefixed command-line versions of dialog-based commands (such as -LAYER, -HATCH, -BLOCK, -INSERT, -XREF, -STYLE, -PLOT, -DIMSTYLE) usable from scripts, with FILEDIA and related variables controlling dialogs.

source.ref: About Switching Between Dialog Boxes and the Command Line

acceptance.sketch: -HATCH Properties ANSI31 1 0 then pick point creates hatch; no dialog displayed.

statement: STATUS reports object counts, limits, extents, display extents, insertion base, snap and grid spacing, current space, and memory and disk figures in the current UNITS format; TIME reports the drawing's creation, last-update, total editing, elapsed-timer and next autosave times.

acceptance.sketch: STATUS shows number of objects in drawing and base points.

statement: Support command macro strings with ^C^C cancellation, semicolon or space for Enter, a backslash to pause for user input, apostrophe for transparent use, * for repeat, underscore for global names, and $M= DIESEL expressions.

source.ref: About Special Control Characters in Command Macros

acceptance.sketch: Macro ^C^CLINE;0,0;10,0;; draws a line.

notes: Verified against help page "About Special Control Characters in Command Macros". Corrected: '[pause]' is not macro syntax; the pause character is a backslash and Enter is a semicolon. | prior app hint: cand2 app registers RunMacro; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Record a sequence of commands as an action macro, stop recording with ACTSTOP, insert pauses for user input during playback with ACTUSERINPUT, and play back from the Action Recorder panel or by entering the macro name, with macro files managed by ACTMANAGER.

acceptance.sketch: Record two commands, playback repeats with prompt for input.

notes: Verified against help page "ACTRECORD (Command)". Corrected: There is no ACTION command; playback is from the Action Recorder panel or by typing the macro name. Paths come from ACTRECPATH and ACTPATH. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-6E613662-D0B1-4AD2-803A-15C00070FDDE ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1B263E51-BF31-498E-A4EF-A32484AE8557 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1DA03958-D894-4FD4-BCA2-42C5517D2FE3 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers RecordMacro, RunMacro; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Provide an Options dialog with tabs for files, display, open and save, plot and publish, system, user preferences, drafting, 3D modeling, selection and profiles.

acceptance.sketch: Change autosave path; Profile export contains settings.

source.ref: About Setting the Behavior of Dockable Windows, Palettes, and Toolbars

acceptance.sketch: PURGE All * N (script) removes unused items without prompts.

statement: Support startup switches such as /b (script), /ld (load ARX/DBX), /p (profile), /s (support paths), /t (template), /v, /w, /set, /nologo and /nossm, and provide a headless Core Console that takes /i drawing, /s script, /l language, /product and /readonly.

source.ref: Command Line Switch Reference / AutoCAD Core Console

acceptance.sketch: accoreconsole /i X.dwg /s run.scr executes the script headless and exits.

notes: Verified against help page "Command Line Switch Reference". Corrected: /product and /l are Core Console switches (accoreconsole.exe), not main-program switches; the main switch reference does not list /product or /l.
